tagline.en_US: Create a customizable landing page that collects your social and website links. LinkStack stores its application files and data in /htdocs.

description.en_US: LinkStack is a customizable link sharing platform designed to host multiple links on a single landing page. It allows users to create a personal profile page to share their web presence across platforms that only permit a single link. The platform includes an administrative panel for managing links and page customization.
